paths.description: Node project roots (each needs package.json + lockfile).

conformance.description: Default: true for miniapp and bridge, else false.

postgres.description: ci-v9.1: start the ephemeral Postgres 17 step and set TB_TEST_DATABASE_URL for the unit step. Default false (no database step).

distBaseUrl.description: ci-v9.6: public dist host for the release assets of a private repo. Package tarball URLs written at release time (workspace deps) and checked in consumers point at <base>/<repo>-<release tag>/<file>. Default (absent): GitHub releases of this repo. Env TB_DIST_BASE_URL overrides. Only the listed hosts are accepted.

preReleaseChecks.description: ci-v9.6: repo-relative TypeScript scripts run as `node <file>` from the repo root by the pre-release step on every pipeline (a green pipeline = gate passed before tagging) and again by the release Action on the tag, before images/tarballs are built. Non-zero exit blocks the release. Env: TB_PRE_RELEASE=1, TB_RELEASE_TAG (empty outside tags), TB_DIST_BASE_URL (when set). No tokens.

packScripts.description: ci-v9.7: { "<package dir>": "<repo-relative .ts>" }. On a <dir>-v<semver> tag the release Action runs `node <script> --out <empty dir>` from the repo root (after install, build and preReleaseChecks; no tokens) instead of the template's npm pack. The script must write exactly <scope-name>-<version>.tgz of the tagged package; the template checks name/version and the pack guard and publishes .tgz + .sha256 + .integrity computed from the bytes.

id.description: GHSA-, CVE- or OSV id of the vulnerability; matches the finding's id or any alias.

reason.description: Why the repo accepts this vulnerability (at least 10 characters).

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The first day the entry no longer applies. Must be after the day the check runs and at most 90 days after it; osv-check fails on an expired entry or one more than 90 days ahead.

osvIgnore.description: ci-v9.14 (C262): vulnerabilities this repo accepts for a limited time. The osv-check step fails on any HIGH or CRITICAL (CVSS >= 7.0; unknown severity counts as HIGH) vulnerability in the pnpm/npm lockfiles that no valid entry names. An entry that matches nothing prints a warning (stale).

skip.description: Must be true. Remove the whole bootSmoke key to run the smoke.

reason.description: Why this miniapp cannot be boot-smoke-tested yet (at least 10 characters).

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The first day the opt-out no longer applies. Must be after the day the step runs and at most 90 days after it; boot-smoke fails on an expired opt-out or one more than 90 days ahead.

bootSmoke.description: ci-v9.17 (L68): the only way to skip the boot smoke of a kind miniapp repo (the pre-release step starts the built entry and requires a healthy answer of the manifest health path). Limited time: reason + expiry at most 90 days ahead.

releaseOn.description: ci-v9.10 (C222): who publishes this repo's releases. "actions" (default): .github/workflows/opt2-release.yml (built-in GITHUB_TOKEN; free only in PUBLIC repos). "woodpecker": .woodpecker/release.yaml (a private repo: GitHub Actions do not start without billing). The Woodpecker release builds without any token and publishes with the repo secret tb_release_token (tag + manual events only). ci-v9.11 (C232): images are allowed; they are built by kaniko (no push) and pushed to ghcr by the release-image-push step alone, with the repo secret tb_ghcr_token (a classic PAT, write:packages only, tag + manual events only). Setup requires exactly one of the two release files.

name.description: Repo name or <repo>-<component>; published as ghcr.io/<lowercased repo owner>/<name> (ci-v9.8: ghcr.io/tealbrick/<name>; releases before C206 are in ghcr.io/martin-atrin).

product.description: Release registry product id (manifest id for miniapps).

kind.description: app/bridge: release-index entry on v* tags; portal: image only; service: companion image of the app with the same product (BSA-01), digest recorded in that app's release entry.

upgradeFrom.description: semver range of versions allowed to update to this release

service.description: kind service only: the manifest runtime.services[].id this image implements.
